name: Print FIRST: joystick test corner v2
note: One piece; no shims. Existing PETG, 0.10 mm layers, visible face down. Support the shallow recess; read the v2 guide before slicing.

name: 01 case
note: Open side up; supports in USB tunnel only if your slicer needs them.

name: 02 Integrated top plate v2 — WAIT
note: Do not print until the small corner passes. Built-in joystick supports; see v2 guide. Visible face down with support in the shallow recess.

name: 03 round foot
note: Flat bottom DOWN. Washer pockets face up; secure washers with tape before assembly.

name: 05 touch cap
note: Visible face DOWN. Bond 13 mm copper disk immediately beneath the 0.8 mm top skin.

name: 06 encoder knob
note: Socket DOWN; short bridging above nut pocket. Trial fit the D socket before pressing fully. Adhesive optional after testing.

name: 07 led baffle
note: Black filament, cavity UP. LED PCB on floor, insulated pads underneath. Six identical cups.

name: 08 keycap 1u
note: Flat top, 0.5 mm beveled rim. Print 6 clear and 5 white, top UP; 0.10-0.12 mm layers with a 0.4 mm nozzle. Support underside as needed, keep sockets clear. Test one cap first.

name: 09 keycap 2u dual stem
note: Flat top, 0.5 mm beveled rim; white PETG, top UP. Support underside as needed, keep sockets clear. Two MX sockets 19.05 mm apart; fits two switches, not a centered stabilizer. Test fit first.

name: 10 switch fit coupon
note: Left/middle/right from top: 14.0 / 14.1 / 14.2 mm. Choose snug clip fit before full print.

name: 11 stem insert coupon
note: Cross fits -0.05 / nominal / +0.05, then 3.9 mm insert pocket. Sockets UP for inspection.
